skill.name: data-engineering-data-pipeline
skill.description: Guides the design, implementation, monitoring, and operation of scalable batch and streaming data pipelines.
skill.summary: Design reliable data pipelines with ingestion, orchestration, quality checks, storage, monitoring, and cost controls.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by ordinary data engineering terminology and a Python markdown code fence. No malicious intent, prompt injection, executable helper script, or unsafe command pattern was found in SKILL.md.

The line discusses storage partition sizing for data pipeline cost optimization. It is unrelated to system discovery or reconnaissance behavior.

content.value_statement: Data pipeline projects often fail because architecture, quality, observability, and operations are planned separately. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code produce practical pipeline designs, checklists, and implementation plans.
actual_capabilities: Designs ETL, ELT, Lambda, Kappa, and Lakehouse pipeline architectures.
Plans batch and streaming ingestion with retries, watermarks, and replay handling.
Recommends Airflow, Prefect, dbt, Spark, Delta Lake, and Iceberg patterns.
Defines data quality checks using Great Expectations and dbt tests.
Outlines monitoring, alerting, cost optimization, and operations deliverables.
limitations: Does not validate live cloud resources or production credentials.
Does not replace workload testing with real data volumes.
Requires user-provided sources, targets, latency needs, and governance constraints.
Generated code and infrastructure plans need environment-specific review.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Analytics Pipeline
use_cases.description: Create an end-to-end architecture for batch ingestion, transformation, storage, quality checks, and reporting.

use_cases.title: Improve Streaming Reliability
use_cases.description: Review a streaming workflow for offset handling, retries, replay, monitoring, and operational recovery.

use_cases.title: Standardize Data Quality Controls
use_cases.description: Define validation suites, freshness checks, failure handling, and test coverage for trusted data products.

prompt_templates.title: Outline a Basic Pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a simple batch workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a batch data pipeline for [source] to [target]. Include ingestion, transformation, storage, validation, and monitoring steps.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an Architecture Pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare ETL, ELT, Lambda, Kappa, and Lakehouse patterns for [use case]. Recommend one option with tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Review Pipeline Reliability
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this pipeline design for reliability gaps: [design]. Focus on retries, idempotency, schema evolution, alerts, and recovery.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Operations Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production operations plan for [pipeline]. Include SLAs, dashboards, alert thresholds, runbooks, scaling, cost controls, and rollback steps.

output_examples.input: Design a daily orders pipeline from PostgreSQL to a lakehouse.
output_examples.output: A batch architecture with incremental watermarks, validation, Delta Lake storage, dbt transformations, Airflow scheduling, freshness checks, and alerting.

output_examples.input: Review a Kafka pipeline that loses events during failures.
output_examples.output: A reliability review covering transactional offset commits, replay strategy, idempotent sinks, dead letter handling, metrics, and recovery procedures.

output_examples.input: Create monitoring requirements for executive reporting data.
output_examples.output: A monitoring plan with freshness targets, row count checks, quality score tracking, dashboard metrics, alert severity levels, and ownership.

best_practices: Provide source systems, data volume, latency targets, and downstream consumers before requesting an architecture.
Ask for failure modes, recovery steps, and observability requirements with every production pipeline design.
Validate generated plans with platform limits, security rules, and real workload tests.
anti_patterns: Do not request a full production design without data volume, freshness, and ownership requirements.
Do not treat sample code as deployable without security, access, and performance review.
Do not ignore data quality, lineage, and alerting until after implementation.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps plan data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, storage, quality, monitoring, and operations.

faq.question: Can it generate implementation code?
faq.answer: It can outline implementation patterns and sample components, but teams must adapt and test them.

faq.question: Does it support streaming pipelines?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers Kafka-style consumers, offset handling, windows, replay, and failure handling.

faq.question: Which tools does it reference?
faq.answer: It references Airflow, Prefect, dbt, Spark, Great Expectations, Delta Lake, Iceberg, CloudWatch, Prometheus, and Grafana.

faq.question: Can it optimize pipeline costs?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests partitioning, file sizing, lifecycle policies, compute choices, and query optimization.

faq.question: Is it safe for production decisions?
faq.answer: Use it for planning and review. Production changes still require environment testing and expert approval.
